title: Suppression
description: A suppression rule: findings that match its scope are suppressed, now and in every later scan, until it expires. Every apply writes the suppression audit. Rules created from a VexSource are owned by that source and cannot be declared here.

type.description: The decision: false_positive (the finding is wrong), wont_fix, risk_accepted, mitigated (a control outside the code covers it) or deferred.

reason.description: Why, for the people who review suppressions.

justification.description: Why the product is not affected, in the OpenVEX vocabulary, for VEX documents minted from this rule.

scope.description: What the rule matches. It must name at least one of rule, target or path; a rule that names none would match everything. Every field given must match.

category.description: The finding category. crypto and ai are inventory components (a CBOM algorithm, certificate, key or library; an AIBOM agent, SDK, model or service), which match on target.

rule.description: The vulnerability or rule id: a CVE or other advisory id, or a SAST, IaC or secrets rule id.

target.description: An inventory component's identity: an algorithm SPDX id, a certificate subject, a purl or a model name.

purl.description: Only findings in this package. Without a version, every version.

path.description: A file path, relative to the repository root.

lineRange.description: A range of lines in path.

expires.description: When the rule stops applying. Left out, it never expires; reports flag it once it goes unreviewed for the RemediationPolicy suppressionReviewMaxAgeDays.

when.description: An extra condition a finding must meet, over the finding variables.
